prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for home intro: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout showcasing desktop pet interactions before finishing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Your companion lives on your screen. Learn how to interact, minimize, or customize them."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality traits selection screen: Insert a new pet personality trait selection screen into the adoption flow before picking or customizing a pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_personality_traits", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"], "new_personality_traits": {"headline": "Choose Pet Personality", "body": "Select unique traits for your desktop pet companion.", "layout": "grid"}}
2: [home, wait_info] Notify when ready toggle on waiting screen: Add a system notification toggle and estimated time remaining indicator on the pet generation waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet...", "body": "We are generating your 3D pet assets. You can close or minimize this window."}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for pick friend: Redesign the pick friend screen to a two-column layout with side-by-side pet previews and detail cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "body": "Select a pet friend to bring onto your desktop."}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Path selection clarity headline and hint: Clarify path selection headlines and add a helpful hint explaining that additional pets can be added later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Adoption Path", "body": "Choose between ready-to-adopt pets or create a custom pet from photos.", "hint": "You can adopt additional pets anytime from settings later."}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Photo submission tips on upload screen: Add a interactive photo quality tip carousel component to the photo upload screen to guide custom pet image uploads.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Upload Pet Photos", "body": "Provide clear, well-lit photos of your pet for best 3D generation.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [sign_in, incentive] Account sync progress badge on sign in screen: Add a visual progress badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that their pet adoption data is being saved.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Adoption Progress Saved", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop interaction hint on home intro screen: Add a clear hint to the home intro screen detailing drag-and-drop and right-click desktop overlay controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Drag your pet anywhere on your desktop, or right-click them to access controls and chat."}}
8: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in screen before path selection: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the initial story screen and before path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "sign_in", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
9: [sign_in, layout] Compact layout for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout to reduce visual friction and speed up account creation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Pet", "body": "Connect your account so your desktop companion is always saved."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign of home intro layout remains within onboarding limits and preserves screen job.
Adding a new personality traits screen inside onboarding is allowed and retains all required steps.
Time estimate indicator during real wait time is allowed under Rule 5 and waiting screen job is preserved.
Layout redesign for pick friend screen preserves pet selection job and steps.
Clarifying copy and adding a hint on choose path screen maintains both adoption options and avoids price references.
Adding photo tip carousel component to photo upload screen is valid design enhancement inside onboarding.
Adding a progress saved badge to sign in screen is valid within onboarding.
Adding desktop interaction hints to home intro screen is allowed.
Reordering sign in screen after story screen is explicitly permitted under Rule 4 while preserving all required steps.
Compact layout update for sign in screen retains screen job and compliance rules.
